name: ai-knowledge-lab
description: Read-only Knowledge Lab tools. Agents: lab_discover then lab_invoke. Add domain tools here without editing SKILL.md.

tools.name: lab_discover
tools.description: Discover available Knowledge Lab capabilities. Returns tool names, short descriptions, and invoke hints. Call this before lab_invoke. Catalog grows without changing SKILL.md.

query.description: Optional keyword to filter tools (e.g. article, project, tag)

tools.name: lab_invoke
tools.description: Invoke a discovered tool by name. Resolve the tool from /api/discover.json or /mcp/tools.json, then GET its static path (or path_template with args).

static.note: Look up tool.static.path or tool.static.path_template; substitute args; HTTP GET.

tools.name: lab_get_skill
tools.description: Read the Knowledge Lab SKILL.md — required first step for any agent using this site.

tools.name: lab_get_product
tools.description: Read PRODUCT.md vision, P0 scope, and P1–P3 roadmap.

tools.name: lab_list_entries
tools.description: List all knowledge entries (articles, thinking, projects, videos) with id, title, tags, urls.

type.description: Optional filter: Articles | Diverse Lab | Projects | Videos

tools.name: lab_search_entries
tools.description: Search entries by keyword against title, excerpt, and tags using the catalog index.

tools.name: lab_get_entry
tools.description: Fetch one entry's canonical Markdown by id (preferred over HTML).

id.description: Entry id from catalog, e.g. agent-control-plane

tools.name: lab_list_tags
tools.description: List tags and the entry ids under each tag.

tools.name: lab_get_project_writeup
tools.description: Get a project writeup (Problem→Lessons Learned) by project id: concurrency | redpacket | miaoshao.
